← Enclosure Lab · D2.6
ENCLOSURE LAB / EXPERIMENT

Redline R2

MAC MINI M1 / FDM / 186 × 124 × 47.1 mm WITH FEET

A ThinkPad and MikroTik inspired FDM enclosure with a D2.6 style rear panel. Eight shaped openings keep the connector frames behind the plastic.

Individual openings, with the port labels close to the sockets.

Open the image for a closer look.

Saved views

Unpowered fit prototype. The separate power bay is laid out for fixed 20 V USB-C PD and a regulated 12 V converter. Physical fit, power, cooling and wireless performance remain untested.

Enclosure: Univera LLC. Board and heatsink reference: Quinn Nelson / SnazzyLabs, Printables 139893, CC BY-NC (version unspecified). The board geometry uses the D2.6 registration and connector details. Enclosure license · Third-party notices.
